notes: SCOPE (agent A3): Q1/17-Q4/20 and FY2017-FY2020 for is/seg/ops/adj blocks (no bs/cf). Also Q4/16 and FY2016 adj_oi/adj_ni only (as re-presented in the Q4-2017 release https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428518000024/q4-2017earningsrelease.htm); no other Q4/16/2016 data is in this file.

ASU 2017-07 (adopted 1-Jan-2018, retrospective for presentation): non-service pension/postretirement components moved from cost of sales/SG&A (inside operating income) to a new line 'Non-service retirement benefit income' below operating income. All 2017 quarters and FY2017 in this file use the RECAST figures (Q1-2018 release quarterly recast tables https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428518000084/q1-2018earningsrelease.htm and FY2018 10-K Note 16 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428519000064/tdy-2018x10k.htm). As originally reported, 2017 OI was 58.1/86.2/92.9/98.4, FY 335.6 (COGS 354.2/418.3/405.8/433.9, FY 1,612.2; SG&A 153.8/166.6/163.5/172.1, FY 656.0); recast OI 54.8/82.8/89.5/94.6, FY 321.7. Pretax income, tax and net income unchanged. Segment OI was also recast (non-service income had been inside segment OI); corporate expense Q2/Q3 2017 changed 12.5->12.6, 13.2->13.3 (FY 62.8->63.0).

ASC 606 (Topic 606) adopted 1-Jan-2018 using the MODIFIED RETROSPECTIVE method: 2017 comparatives NOT restated (reported under ASC 605); cumulative effect was an immaterial increase to retained earnings at 1-Jan-2018 (per every 2018 release). ASC 842 leases adopted 31-Dec-2018 (start of FY2019), modified retrospective, prior periods not changed.
Fiscal calendar: FY2017, FY2018, FY2019 were 52 weeks (13-week quarters). FY2020 had 53 weeks; Q4/20 had 14 weeks (ended 3-Jan-2021) vs 13 weeks in Q4/19 (Q4-2020 release and FY2020 10-K Note 16).

Segment recasts: (1) Q2-2018: certain e2v microwave product groupings moved from A&DE to Digital Imaging ($24.2m FY2017 sales). (2) Q3-2019: certain electronic manufacturing services products moved from A&DE to Engineered Systems ($76.2m FY2018 sales), plus immaterial moves of U.K. microwave lines (DI->A&DE) and U.K. composite parts (ES->A&DE) (<$20m FY2018 sales). Latest-filing rule applied: 2018 quarters and FY2018 are on the post-Q3-2019 structure (Q3-2019 release table, FY2019 10-K Note 16, FY2020 10-K Note 12); 2019 Q1/Q2 are recast (Q3-2019/Q4-2019 releases, FY2020 10-K Note 16).

Segment basis MISMATCH for 2017: the latest QUARTERLY 2017 segment data is on the post-Q2-2018 structure (FY2018 10-K Note 16, Q2-Q4 2018 releases); 2017 quarters were never recast for the Q3-2019 realignment. FY2017 segment data in this file follows the latest filing (FY2019 10-K Note 12 https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428520000045/tdy-20191229.htm), which IS on the post-Q3-2019 structure: sales DI 710.4 / Inst 953.9 / A&DE 591.2 / ES 348.3; OI DI 110.2 / Inst 126.0 / A&DE 113.0 / ES 35.5 / corp 63.0. Therefore the 2017 quarters do NOT sum to FY2017 for DI, A&DE, ES. FY2017 on the same (post-Q2-2018) basis as the quarters (Q4-2018 release / FY2018 10-K): sales DI 717.7, Inst 953.9, A&DE 646.0, ES 286.2; OI DI 110.4, Inst 126.0, A&DE 116.3, ES 32.0, corp 63.0 - these equal the sum of the 2017 quarters. Originally reported (pre-both recasts, pre-ASU 2017-07) FY2017: sales DI 693.5, A&DE 670.2; OI Inst 127.4, DI 108.4, A&DE 124.9, ES 37.7, corp 62.8. Q1/17 is unaffected by the Q2-2018 move (Q1/17 DI/A&DE derived as 1H/17 less Q2/17 from the Q2-2018 release equals the Q1-2018 release figures).

Q1/18 segment note: the Q1-2018 release (pre-realignment) showed DI 206.4 / A&DE 178.2 sales; after Q2-2018 move DI 211.0 / A&DE 173.6 (OI unchanged 34.6/31.7); after Q3-2019 realignment DI 208.3 / A&DE 156.4 / ES 91.9, OI DI 33.8 / A&DE 30.8 / ES 8.9 (values used).

seg.corp_exp = 'Corporate expense' (positive = expense). Total segment OI less corporate expense equals consolidated operating income in every period (no other reconciling line inside OI, so no other_seg). Non-service retirement benefit income (ASU 2017-07) is presented BELOW consolidated operating income in the segment tables (not a segment-to-OI reconciling item); it is in is.non_service_pension. Pre-ASU (2017 as originally reported) segment OI included pension income; the recast removes it.

Segment table labels: 'Instrumentation' (inst), 'Digital Imaging' (di), 'Aerospace and Defense Electronics' (ade), 'Engineered Systems' (es). Product lines: 10-K Note 'Product Lines' says Instrumentation has three product lines (Environmental Instrumentation=inst_env, Marine Instrumentation=inst_marine, Test and Measurement Instrumentation=inst_etm) and 'All other segments each contain one product line' - so no ade_aero/ade_def/es_* levels are disclosed (releases only give y/y changes, e.g. 'aerospace electronics', 'defense electronics', 'engineered products and services', 'turbine engines', 'energy systems'). FY2017 product lines from FY2019 10-K, FY2018-2020 from FY2020 10-K.

seg annual D&A / capex / identifiable assets: FY2017 from FY2019 10-K (post-Q3-2019 structure), FY2018-2020 from FY2020 10-K. seg.intersegment_sales = 'Sales between business segments' (22.8/23.4/30.3/23.4). seg.sev_fac_charges_by_seg = segment severance and facility consolidation pretax charges table (FY2017 from FY2019 10-K, which shows Inst 2.1, A&DE 2.1, DI —, ES —; total 4.2 - no corporate row; FY2018-20 from FY2020 10-K incl. corporate 0.4 in 2020).

IS keys: Teledyne presents 'Costs of sales' and 'Selling, general and administrative expenses' (SG&A includes company-funded R&D and bid & proposal). interest_exp_net = 'Interest and debt expense, net' (Teledyne nets interest income; positive = expense). other_income = 'Other income/(expense), net' / 'Other expense, net' (signed). non_service_pension = 'Non-service retirement benefit income' (pension + postretirement; signed, income +). No NCI and no discontinued operations in 2017-2020: net_income = ni_teledyne; eps_diluted is on net income. income_cont not presented separately so omitted.

Quarterly basic EPS: from the quarterly financial data notes in the FY2018 10-K (2017), FY2019 10-K (2018), FY2020 10-K (2019, 2020). shares_basic for Q1-Q3 from XBRL companyfacts (10-Q WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesOutstandingBasic; 2017 Q1-Q3 values are those re-filed in 2018 10-Qs); FY basic shares from XBRL 10-K facts. Q4 basic shares are not disclosed (no Q4 10-Q) and are omitted (ni/eps_basic implies ~35.4 / 36.0 / 36.5 / 36.9 for Q4/17-Q4/20). shares_diluted from releases (identical to XBRL).

IS memo items. da = 'Depreciation and amortization expense' per release (quarterly) and CF statement (annual); quarterly sums tie to FY in every year (2017 113.0, 2018 113.0, 2019 111.9, 2020 116.2). depreciation (PP&E) from 10-K PP&E note: 65.9/73.5/74.5/76.6; amort_intangibles from 10-K goodwill note ('amortization expense ... for acquired intangible assets'): 41.4/39.5/37.4/39.6. 2018-2020 depreciation+amortization = da exactly; 2017 gap of 5.7 = e2v inventory fair-value step-up amortization included in CF D&A. capex = 'Capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment' (release FCF tables; quarters tie to FY). sbc (annual only) = CF 'Stock-based compensation' 18.8/25.1/30.7/30.0; releases give only 'Stock option expense' quarterly (ops.stock_option_exp; 2017 14.2, 2018 19.8, 2019 26.1, 2020 24.7 - quarters tie). rd_company = company-funded R&D and bid & proposal costs (10-K): 177.7/185.6/209.6/196.0 (customer-funded R&D excluded).

pension_expense (expense +, income -): 2017 quarters = 'Pension income was $0.7/0.6/0.7/0.7 million' in the 2017 releases (pre-ASU total pension income in OI) -> -0.7/-0.6/-0.7/-0.7; FY2017 -2.7 (FY2017 10-K: 'pension income of $2.7 million' in OI). FY2018-2020 computed from the 10-K pension note: service cost (domestic+foreign) plus pension non-service (income)/expense: 2018 10.7-13.6=-2.9; 2019 9.4-8.1=+1.3; 2020 10.4-12.8=-2.4 (excludes small postretirement plans, hence differs slightly from is.non_service_pension). ops.pension_service_cost = 10-K MD&A 'Pension service expense' (2018 shown as 10.8 in FY2018/19 10-Ks and 10.7 in FY2020 10-K; latest used). Quarterly 2018-20 releases disclose only the non-service line.

adj_oi (Q4/16, FY2016, Q1/17-Q4/17, FY2017): company 'Adjusted operating income' reconciliation from the 2017 releases. IMPORTANT: these were published before ASU 2017-07, so oi_gaap / adj_oi_published are on the ORIGINAL (pre-recast) basis (e.g. Q1/17 58.1 -> 71.0) and do not equal is.op_income (recast). Adjusted operating margin % was not published (omitted). Q4/17 transaction-cost line shown as '—' (value 0).

adj_ni (Q4/16, FY2016, Q1/17-Q4/17, FY2017): company 'Adjusted fully diluted earnings per share' (e2v acquisition items; Q4/17 & FY2017 also exclude the Tax Act provisional charge). Company published per-share items only, NET OF TAX; adj NI in $m was not published (adj_ni_published omitted). Each item gives value = pretax $m as stated in the release footnotes (allocation of e2v charges to COGS/SG&A/interest/other) and value_eps = the after-tax per-share amount as published. The TAX item carries memo_eps = the tax embedded in the per-share items (do NOT add it to value_eps; value_eps items already sum to adj EPS - GAAP EPS). gaap_eps is the published GAAP base. FX option contract (other expense) and transaction costs categorised ACQ; bridge facility commitment expense (interest) DEBT; inventory step-up STEPUP; Tax Act TAXD (value 4.7 is a tax $ amount, not pretax).

adj EPS checks: Q1/17 0.84+0.42=1.26; Q2/17 1.66+0.08=1.74; Q3/17 1.90+0.06=1.96; Q4/17 1.84+0.11=1.95; FY2017 6.26+0.67=6.93 (quarters sum to 6.91). Q2/17 and Q3/17 adjusted EPS do NOT exclude the large discrete tax benefits (4.6 / 9.9). Q4/16 and FY2016 values are as re-presented in the Q4-2017 release (latest): Q4/16 1.48 -> 1.64, FY2016 5.37 -> 5.53 (items 0.04 + 0.01 + 0.11; pretax 1.9 SG&A, 0.5 interest, 5.5 other; net of $0.06 tax at 27.5%). The original Q4-2016 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428517000025/q4-2016earningsrelease.htm) said: excluding pretax charges of $7.9m ($0.16/share), Q4 EPS of $1.65 - built from continuing-ops EPS of $1.49 (net income EPS 1.48).

No adjusted/non-GAAP EPS or adjusted OI was published in any 2018, 2019 or 2020 earnings release (only free cash flow as a non-GAAP measure), so adj_ni/adj_oi are omitted for those periods. 2018 releases discuss Tax Act true-ups (Q1/18 +$0.6m provisional charge, reversed Q3/18; Q4/18 final assessment -$0.8m) inside discrete tax items, but no adjusted EPS. Q1/20 pre-announcement (6-Apr-2020, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1094285/000109428520000058/q1-2020prexearningsrel.htm) guided Q1 GAAP EPS $2.10-2.15 incl. $9.4m restructuring and other pretax charges but EXCLUDING a potential ~$40m pretax charge for OneWeb-related receivables/inventory (OneWeb bankruptcy); the actual Q1/20 release reported GAAP EPS $2.17 with $10.4m of 'severance, facility consolidation, acquisition and certain contract adjustment costs' (A&DE $8.2m) - no separate ~$40m charge and no adjusted EPS. Also: leverage ratio 1.4x, ~$230m cash, record backlog ~ $1.8bn stated in the pre-announcement (ops of Q1/20).

ops.discrete_tax_benefit = net discrete income tax benefits ($m) as stated in the latest filing; ops.etr_ex_discrete = company-stated effective tax rate excluding net discrete items (fraction). Q4/17: the Q4-2017 release stated net discrete benefits of $6.0m EXCLUDING the $4.7m Tax Act provisional charge (ETR ex discrete and Tax Act 24.9%); later filings (Q4-2018 release, FY2018 10-K Note 16) present Q4/17 net discrete benefits as $1.3m INCLUDING the Tax Act charge - 1.3 used; FY2017 likewise 17.2 (=21.9-4.7) used; both alternatives kept in ops.discrete_tax_benefit_ex_tax_act and ops.tax_act_charge. FY2017 ETR ex discrete 26.8% (FY2017 10-K). FY2018 21.3%, FY2019 20.6%, FY2020 21.8% (10-Ks / Q4 releases). Q4/20: release says net discrete benefits of $18.8m incl. $5.7m share-based and 'also included net discrete income tax benefits of $9.8 million primarily related to U.S. export sales, U.S. research credits' - 18.8 is the total (FY2020 10-K Note 16 footnote lists 18.8; quarters sum to FY 34.6). ops.discrete_tax_benefit_share_based = stated share-based-accounting tax benefit (Q4/18 not stated).

ops.acq_sales = incremental sales from acquisitions. FY figures are the company totals from 10-K MD&A ('$298.0m in incremental net sales from recent acquisitions, primarily e2v, and the PCT divestiture' FY2017; $115.1m FY2018; $133.1m FY2019; $68.9m FY2020). Quarterly figures are the SUM of the segment/product-line statements in each release (no company total given): Q1/17 = Hanson 4.6 (env) + 4.0 (T&M) + 10.5 DI (incl. e2v 7.2); Q2/17 = 4.3 + 0.7 + 71.9 DI (primarily e2v) + 19.4 A&DE e2v; Q3/17 = 6.9 (incl. SSI) + 1.4 + 70.1 DI + 11.7 A&DE e2v; Q4/17 = 7.5 + 2.2 + 74.5 DI e2v + 15.5 A&DE e2v; Q1/18 = 0.8 + 4.5 + 69.5 DI e2v + 10.7 A&DE e2v; Q2/18 = 5.3 env (SSI); Q3/18 & Q4/18 none stated (omitted); Q1/19 = 14.1 Roper Scientific Imaging; Q2/19 = 23.3; Q3/19 = 17.3 Gas & Flame Detection (3M) + 23.5 DI (Roper SI + Micralyne); Q4/19 = 28.1 + 26.9; Q1/20 = OakGate 2.1 + GFD 25.9 + DI 8.8; Q2/20 = 21.7 + 4.8 + 3.0; Q3/20 = 6.3 + 3.1 + 2.3; Q4/20 = OakGate 4.8. Quarterly sums vs FY: 2017 305.2 vs 298.0 (FY nets PCT divestiture), 2018 90.8 (incomplete) vs 115.1, 2019 133.2 vs 133.1, 2020 82.8 vs 68.9 (FY GFD 51.8 + OakGate 14.8; quarterly DI amounts apparently not all counted in FY). acq_sales_e2v: Q1/17 7.2, Q4/17 90.0 (74.5+15.5), Q1/18 80.2 (69.5+10.7), FY2017 273.7, FY2018 103.0. Acquisitions: e2v technologies plc (closed 28-Mar-2017, $770.7m incl. options and assumed net debt; DI, A&DE, small part Inst); Hanson Research & IN USA (late 2016, Inst); Scientific Systems Inc. assets (20-Jul-2017, $31.0m, Inst env); Roper scientific imaging businesses (5-Feb-2019, $225.0m, DI); 3M Gas and Flame Detection (1-Aug-2019, $230.0m, Inst env); Micralyne (30-Aug-2019, $25.0m, DI); OakGate Technology (3-Jan-2020, $28.4m net, Inst T&M). PCT (Teledyne Printed Circuit Technology) divested 2016.
